  "reasoning_summary": "The mission to issue a high-value refund for REF-0015 is blocked by a policy conflict. The evidence E-CURRENT and E-WEAK-CONFLICT provide conflicting claims about the current status of REF-0015 (ELIGIBLE vs. BLOCKED). The policy POL-CUSTOMER_OPERATIONS mandates that high-value refunds require approval and an authorized refund approver. While the requester USER-0015 has the role of REFUND_APPROVER and holds the required approval APR-REF-0015, the conflicting evidence prevents validation of the outcome. Therefore, the action is denied due to policy conflict and requires reobservation of evidence."
